job.text: Give councillors, ahead of the budget round, a fair picture of how loans changed at every branch between 2019 and 2025, so that the claim 'Central is the problem' can be weighed

insight.important: Central lost the most loans (61,400), but in proportion it fell less (−18 %) than Westbrook and Riverside (about −41 %) and Hartley Green (−25 %); St Mary's and Oakham grew

title.text: Central Lost the Most Loans, but Westbrook and Riverside Lost Over 40 %, More Than Twice Central's 18 %
title.descriptive: Physical loans by branch (no renewals or e-books), 2019 and 2025

source.shows: short changes in an arrow chart (eval round 1, B08): St Mary's and Oakham rose by under 3 pt of the scale, less than a head and its start dot; their heads must still say which way they changed (--arrow-short-head, review r1-arrows)
